outcome: incidence of placenta accreta spectrum disorder
cohort: Pregnant women with a previous cesarean section (N=248)
finding: A short interpregnancy interval does not significantly affect the incidence of placenta previa and placenta accreta spectrum disorder following a cesarean section.
mod_finding: A short interpregnancy interval does not significantly affect the incidence of placenta previa and placenta accreta spectrum disorder following a cesarean section.
